findings.summary: isPublished() omits the DEV bypass that the canonical rule (apps/web/src/utils/data-utils.ts) applies.
findings.mechanism: data-utils.ts's isPublished is `!data.draft && (import.meta.env.DEV || publishDate <= now+offset)` — in dev, future-dated posts still render as published. This plugin's isPublished only checks `publishDate.getTime() <= Date.now() + BRISBANE_OFFSET_MS` with no DEV bypass, so during local dev the transform strips internal links to future-dated posts that the site itself is simultaneously rendering live, contradicting the stated intent of mirroring 'the same rule the rest of the site applies'.
